painterly.label: Pictórico
painterly.base_prompt: Hand-painted romantic 19th-century oil painting on canvas with the fine linework of a steel engraving, as in an illustrated 1850s edition of Goethe's Faust (in the spirit of Delacroix's Faust lithographs and Caspar David Friedrich). Clearly painted, NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D render, NOT digital concept art: visible loose brushstrokes, subtle engraved cross-hatching in the shadows, slightly aged varnish. Muted earthy palette of umber, ochre, slate blue and ivory with restrained deep crimson accents. Soft chiaroscuro, single warm key light from the upper left. Semi-realistic proportions. No text, no letters, no signature, no watermark, no frame, no border.

anime.label: Anime
anime.base_prompt: Japanese anime visual novel art, in the style of a polished modern anime / visual novel (2D cel animation look). Thin, clean, uniform dark lineart; flat colour fills with crisp two-tone cel shading and a single soft highlight; anime facial features (clearly drawn anime eyes with highlights, simplified small nose and mouth) while keeping mature adult anatomy and proportions (not chibi, not childlike, not moe). Definitely NOT semi-realistic, NOT painterly, NOT a realistic illustration, no rendered skin texture. Historically grounded 16th-century German costume and architecture. Harmonious palette of deep indigo, umber, crimson and parchment ivory with gold accents. No text, no letters, no signature, no watermark, no frame, no border.
